title: The Broken Relics
summary: Integrating his shadow half, Ha-Jun absorbs the shattered remnants of the nine physical Relics into a single unified spiritual core within his beating heart.

panels.shot: the 30-foot shadow titan dissolving into sparkling golden rain
panels.action: The colossal shadow dissolves into millions of golden star-particles, raining softly across the black water.
panels.prose_en: The colossal shadow dissolves into millions of golden star-particles, raining softly across the black water.
panels.prose_hi: Vishal chhaya lakhon sunhare taara-kanon mein vilin ho jaati hai aur kale pani mein dhire-dhire barasti hai.

panels.shot: the golden particles swirling in a vortex around ha-jun body
panels.action: The purified energy spirals around Ha-Jun, soaking into his pores, skin, and bone marrow like liquid warmth.
panels.prose_en: The purified energy spirals around Ha-Jun, soaking into his pores, skin, and bone marrow like liquid warmth.
panels.prose_hi: Shuddh urja Ha-Jun ke charon or ghumti hai, taral garmi ki tarah uske chhidron, tvacha aur asthi majja mein sama jaati hai.

panels.shot: all ten relics floating in the air around ha-jun beginning to crack
panels.action: The physical forms of the Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Devourer, and Hourglass hover around him, cracking with golden light.

dialogue.text: The physical vessels were only training wheels.

panels.prose_en: The physical forms of the Feather, Ring, Bone, Heart, Fang, Eye, Chains, Crown, Devourer, and Hourglass hover around him, cracking with golden light.
panels.prose_hi: Pankh, anguthi, haddi, hridy, daant, aankh, janjeer, mukut, bhakshak aur ghantaghar ke bhautik roop uske charon or mandrate han, sunhari roshni se tutate han.

panels.shot: the ten physical relics shattering simultaneously into pure mana shards
panels.action: All ten relics shatter into clouds of brilliant stardust, shedding their mortal physical forms forever.
panels.prose_en: All ten relics shatter into clouds of brilliant stardust, shedding their mortal physical forms forever.
panels.prose_hi: Sabhi das avashesh chamakdar stardust ke baadalon mein bikhar gaye, aur apne nashwar bhautik swaroop ko hamesha ke liye tyaag diya.

panels.shot: kuro watching in stunned, reverent awe as his fallen feather dissolves
panels.action: Kuro watches his original Fallen Feather dissolve into pure starlight, tears of joy shining in his eyes.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: My feather's duty is complete. The true Sovereign has surpassed the relics.

panels.prose_en: Kuro watches his original Fallen Feather dissolve into pure starlight, tears of joy shining in his eyes.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne mool gire hue pankh ko shuddh taron ki roshni mein ghulte hue dekhta hai, uski aankhon mein khushi ke aansu chamak rahe han.

panels.shot: the ten clouds of stardust fusing into a single radiant sphere
panels.action: The ten different types of mana combine into a single miniature sun of pure white, gold, and violet light.
panels.prose_en: The ten different types of mana combine into a single miniature sun of pure white, gold, and violet light.
panels.prose_hi: Das alg-alg prakar ke man shuddh safed, sone aur baingani prakash ke ek ekal laghu surya mein sanyojit hote han.

panels.shot: the singular core descending slowly into ha-jun solar plexus
panels.action: The radiant sphere descends into Ha-Jun's chest, sinking smoothly into his beating heart.
panels.prose_en: The radiant sphere descends into Ha-Jun's chest, sinking smoothly into his beating heart.
panels.prose_hi: Diptiman gola Ha-Jun ki chhati mein utarta hai, aur uske dhadkate dil mein aasani se doob jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun eyes closing as his entire genetic code undergoes divine evolution
panels.action: Inside his cells, the double-helix DNA strands turn to radiant platinum-black stardust.
panels.prose_en: Inside his cells, the double-helix DNA strands turn to radiant platinum-black stardust.
panels.prose_hi: Uski koshikaon ke ander, duble-helix dna strand chamakdar platinam-kale stardust mein badal jaate han.

panels.shot: system notification window appearing for the final time
panels.action: The interface appears, glowing in pure celestial platinum: '[BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 95.0% - ASCENDANT MONARCH REACHED]'.
panels.prose_en: The interface appears, glowing in pure celestial platinum: '[BLOODLINE SYNCHRONIZATION: 95.0% - ASCENDANT MONARCH REACHED]'.
panels.prose_hi: Interfess shuddh akashiya platinum mein chamakta hua dikhai deta hai: '[raktarekha tulyakalan: 95.0% - aarohi samrat tak pahunch gaya]'.

panels.shot: the black ocean beneath his feet turning into crystal-clear mirror glass
panels.action: The dark water transforms into a mirror of pure clear diamond, reflecting an endless sky of golden dawns.
panels.prose_en: The dark water transforms into a mirror of pure clear diamond, reflecting an endless sky of golden dawns.
panels.prose_hi: Kala pani shuddh pardarshi heere ke darpan mein badal jata hai, jo sunhare bhor ke antaheen aakash ko darshata hai.

panels.shot: the phantom of asmodaius kneeling before ha-jun with bowed head
panels.action: First Sovereign Asmodaius appears, kneeling on one knee with head bowed: 'You have done what I could not. You are the True Sovereign.'

dialogue.speaker: asmodaius
dialogue.text: My reign is finished. Rule the cosmos with mercy, Ha-Jun.

panels.prose_en: First Sovereign Asmodaius appears, kneeling on one knee with head bowed: 'You have done what I could not. You are the True Sovereign.'.
panels.prose_hi: Subse pehle samprabhu esmodius prakat hota hai, ek ghutne par sir jhukaye: 'tumne wah kiya hai jo main nahin kar saka. aap sacche samprabhu han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun gently placing his hand on asmodaius shoulder raising him up
panels.action: Ha-Jun lifts his ancestor to his feet with a warm smile: 'Thank you for protecting the covenant, Asmodaius. Rest now.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Rest in peace, Asmodaius. Earth is in good hands.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lifts his ancestor to his feet with a warm smile: 'Thank you for protecting the covenant, Asmodaius. Rest now.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne garmjoshi bhari muskan ke saath apne purvaj ko apne pairon par khada kiya: 'vacha ki raksha karne ke liye dhanyavad, esmodius. ab aaram karo.'.

panels.shot: asmodaius phantom dissolving peacefully into the golden sunrise
panels.action: Asmodaius smiles peacefully, dissolving into golden light particles that drift into the morning sky.
panels.prose_en: Asmodaius smiles peacefully, dissolving into golden light particles that drift into the morning sky.
panels.prose_hi: Esmodius shanti se muskurata hai, sunhare prakash kanon mein ghul jata hai jo subah ke aakash mein bahte han.

panels.shot: the mindscape boundary dissolving: reality returning
panels.action: The dreamlike sky recedes; the physical world over Gwanghwamun Square crystallizes back into view.
panels.prose_en: The dreamlike sky recedes; the physical world over Gwanghwamun Square crystallizes back into view.
panels.prose_hi: Swapn jaisa aakash peeche hat jata hai; guangwamun square par bhautik duniya wapas drishya mein aa jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun opening eyes hovering in the sky over seoul
panels.action: Ha-Jun's eyes open: royal violet irises circled by three spinning starlight halos.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun's eyes open: royal violet irises circled by three spinning starlight halos.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ki aankhen khulin: shahi baingani rang ki putliyan teen ghumti hui taron ki roshni se ghiri hui han.

panels.shot: tae-jun, min-jae, and baek looking up from the square with cheers
panels.action: Down in the square, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Captain Baek look up, seeing Ha-Jun's radiant return.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: He's back! Ha-Jun conquered the trial!

panels.prose_en: Down in the square, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Captain Baek look up, seeing Ha-Jun's radiant return.
panels.prose_hi: Neeche chauk men, Tae-Jun, min-je aur captain bak Ha-Jun ki ujjwal wapsi ko dekhte hue upar dekhte han.

panels.shot: the sky above seoul clearing into pristine, cloudless azure blue
panels.action: The red apocalyptic clouds vanish completely; warm, golden autumn sunshine floods the streets of Seoul.
panels.prose_en: The red apocalyptic clouds vanish completely; warm, golden autumn sunshine floods the streets of Seoul.
panels.prose_hi: Lal sarvanashakari badal puri tarah se gayab ho jaate han; garm, sunhari sharad ritu ki dhoop seoul ki sadkon par chha jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun descending like a feather landing beside tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches down on the asphalt with zero sound, his coat settling smoothly around his knees.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches down on the asphalt with zero sound, his coat settling smoothly around his knees.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun shunya dhwani ke saath damar ko chhuta hai, uska coat uske ghutnon ke aaspaas aasani se baith jata hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun wrapping ha-jun in a strong, one-armed brotherly hug
panels.action: Tae-Jun pulls Ha-Jun into a tight hug with his uninjured arm, laughing with sheer relief.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: You did it! You really came back to me!

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun pulls Ha-Jun into a tight hug with his uninjured arm, laughing with sheer relief.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apni bina chot wali baanh se Ha-Jun ko kaskar gale lagata hai aur puri rahat ke saath hansta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun hugging tae-jun tightly: 'i promised you i would.'
panels.action: Ha-Jun buries his face in Tae-Jun's shoulder, smiling warmly: 'I told you I wouldn't leave you alone again.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun buries his face in Tae-Jun's shoulder, smiling warmly: 'I told you I wouldn't leave you alone again.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne Tae-Jun ke kandhe par apna chehra chhipaya aur garmjoshi se muskurate hue kaha: 'maine tumse kaha tha ki main tumhe phir se akela nahin chhodunga.'

panels.shot: ha-jun placing his hand on tae-jun shoulder wound
panels.action: Ha-Jun touches Tae-Jun's pierced shoulder; warm starlight flows from his fingers, instantly sealing the wound without a scar.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun touches Tae-Jun's pierced shoulder; warm starlight flows from his fingers, instantly sealing the wound without a scar.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne Tae-Jun ke chhede hue kandhe ko chhua; uski ungaliyon se garm taare ki roshni bahti hai, jo ghav ko bina kisi nishan ke turant seal kar deti hai.

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun shoulder cooing proudly
panels.action: Kuro ruffles his black feathers: 'Now that the internal trial is finished... There is only one final task.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro ruffles his black feathers: 'Now that the internal trial is finished... There is only one final task.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne apne kale pankh fadfadate hue kaha: 'ab jab aantarik parikshan samapt ho gaya hai... keval ek antim karya bacha hai.'

panels.shot: min-jae jogging up with a clipboard and two fountain pens
panels.action: Min-Jae runs over, grinning: 'The diplomats from forty nations and fifteen demon clans have arrived at City Hall!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: They are waiting for your signature, Your Majesty!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae runs over, grinning: 'The diplomats from forty nations and fifteen demon clans have arrived at City Hall!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je muskurate hue daudta hai: 'chalis deshon aur pandrah rakshas kulon ke rajnayik city hall mein aa gaye han!'

panels.shot: ha-jun laughing playfully: 'your majesty? don't start that, min-jae!'
panels.action: Ha-Jun laughs, lightly punching Min-Jae's arm: 'Call me Your Majesty again and I'll make you do my calculus homework.'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Fair deal! I'll take the title over the math!

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun laughs, lightly punching Min-Jae's arm: 'Call me Your Majesty again and I'll make you do my calculus homework.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun hansta hai, min-je ki baanh par halke se mukka maarta hai: 'mahamahim mujhe phir se bulao aur main tumhe apna calculus homework karwaunga.'

panels.shot: the four companions walking together down the sunlit boulevard
panels.action: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Kuro walk down the wide avenue of Gwanghwamun under warm autumn trees.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, Min-Jae, and Kuro walk down the wide avenue of Gwanghwamun under warm autumn trees.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun, Tae-Jun, min-je, aur Kuro garm sharad ritu ke pedon ke neeche guangwamun ke vistrit raste par chalte han.

panels.shot: citizens lining the sidewalks throwing red and gold flower petals
panels.action: Thousands of civilians line the sidewalks, throwing fresh red rose petals and cheering for their heroes.

dialogue.speaker: citizens
dialogue.text: THANK YOU, HA-JUN! THANK YOU, HEROES!

panels.prose_en: Thousands of civilians line the sidewalks, throwing fresh red rose petals and cheering for their heroes.
panels.prose_hi: Hajaron nagrik footpathon par katarbaddh hokar taji lal gulab ki pankhudiyan fenkte hain aur apne nayakon ki jay-jaikar karte han.

panels.shot: tae-jun catching a falling flower petal smiling at ha-jun
panels.action: Tae-Jun catches a petal in his hand, smiling at Ha-Jun: 'Look at them. You gave them their tomorrow.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Yeh sab tumhari wajah se zinda hain.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun catches a petal in his hand, smiling at Ha-Jun: 'Look at them. You gave them their tomorrow.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun apne haath mein ek pankhudi pakadta hai aur Ha-Jun ko dekhkar muskurata hai: 'unhen dekho. aapne unhen unka kal diya.'

panels.shot: ha-jun shaking his head looking at tae-jun with deep love
panels.action: Ha-Jun shakes his head: 'No, Hyung. We gave them tomorrow. You protected me so I could protect them.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Nahi, Tae-Jun. Hum dono ne mil kar kiya.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun shakes his head: 'No, Hyung. We gave them tomorrow. You protected me so I could protect them.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun ne apna sir hilaya: 'nahin, hung. humne unhen kal diya. aapne meri raksha ki taki main unki raksha kar sakun.'

panels.shot: kuro spreading his dark wings under the sunny sky cawing with joy
panels.action: Kuro takes flight, circling overhead under the brilliant blue sky, his caw echoing with five thousand years of relief.
panels.prose_en: Kuro takes flight, circling overhead under the brilliant blue sky, his caw echoing with five thousand years of relief.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro udaan bharta hai, shandar neele aakash ke neeche sir ke upar chakkar lagata hai, uski con-con mein paanch hazar saal ki rahat goonjati hai.

panels.shot: the group arriving before the grand entrance of city hall cliffhanger
panels.action: The four heroes arrive before the grand granite steps of Seoul City Hall to ratify the eternal peace treaty!

dialogue.text: THE DAWN OF THE TRUE SOVEREIGN HAS ARRIVED.

panels.prose_en: The four heroes arrive before the grand granite steps of Seoul City Hall to ratify the eternal peace treaty!.
panels.prose_hi: Char nayak shashwat shanti sandhi ki pushti karne ke liye seoul city hall ki bhavya granite sidhiyon ke samne pahunchte han!
